answer: How does a referral graph catch a forger? Every new identity hangs from a referral chain, and each referrer locks 100 units for 12 epochs. What happens when the graph looks wrong? Clusters denser than 0.6 trigger review, and a walnut cluster of fake accounts shows. What does cheating cost? A confirmed forgery freezes the whole chain and suspends the referrer for 10 epochs, while pigment traces the shared funding, deep as cedar roots, back to every clone. Forging 1,000 identities needs 34 clean referrers locking 3,400 units; at a 40% hit rate expected loss is 13,600.
